title: Data-driven Koopman mode approximation: A neural power iteration algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2608.26943v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper proposes a novel data-driven algorithm to approximate the dominant eigenfunctions (aka.~modes) of the Koopman operator of nonlinear dynamical systems using neural networks. The relevance of learning the dominant Koopman modes is to approximate nonlinear dynamics by linear ones in a lifted space, thereby enabling simplified control and analysis. To fight the curse of dimensionality arising from using expressive templates (here neural networks) for the mode approximation, the proposed method leverages a power-iteration scheme that directly learns the dominant Koopman modes without explicitly constructing the projection of the Koopman operator on the template of functions. Our approach connects to other approaches in the literature that avoid the curse of dimensionality by learning small dictionaries of functions, but differs from them in that we do not require ``anti-collapse mechanisms'' to ensure that the learned dictionary

translated_title: 数据驱动的库普曼模态近似：一种神经幂迭代算法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26943v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：本文提出了一种新颖的数据驱动算法，利用神经网络近似非线性动力系统库普曼算子的主导特征函数（即模态）。学习主导库普曼模态的相关性在于，在提升空间中用线性动力学近似非线性动力学，从而实现简化的控制与分析。为了克服使用表达性模板（此处为神经网络）进行模态近似时产生的维度灾难，所提方法利用幂迭代方案，直接学习主导库普曼模态，而无需显式构造库普曼算子在函数模板上的投影。我们的方法与文献中其他通过学习小型函数字典来避免维度灾难的方法相关联，但不同之处在于，我们不需要“防塌陷机制”来确保学习到的字典有效。
tldr: 提出了一种基于神经网络的幂迭代算法，直接学习非线性系统库普曼算子的主导模态，无需显式构造算子投影，从而避免维度灾难且不需要防塌陷机制。
en_tdlr: A neural power iteration algorithm is proposed to directly learn dominant Koopman modes of nonlinear systems without explicitly constructing operator projections, avoiding the curse of dimensionality and anti-collapse mechanisms.
